title: Nightlife VIP Pass
scenario: A promoter offers free club entry if you send a student ID and card details.

answers.A: Verify inside the official university/account system.
answers.B: Click/apply/pay quickly before the deadline passes.
answers.C: Reply to the message and ask the sender for proof.
answers.D: Contact the relevant office using published contact details.

explanation: Nightlife VIP Pass: the trap is to make money or value leave before the story is verified. The safer move is to verify through an official or approved channel, not to act before verifying.
proTip: Event perks should be purchased or verified through official venues.
